deities.name: Thalunesh
deities.rationale: Wandering, glamour, masks, timing, tricks, and fey mischief directly match Thalunesh’s domains.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Nephthysra
deities.rationale: Courtly beauty, charisma, masks, and emotional presence are commonly interpreted through Nephthysra.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Freyseth
deities.rationale: Court bargains, dangerous promises, and threshold etiquette make Freyseth an important cautionary patron.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Sokhivar
deities.rationale: Music, performance, and freedom in open-air courts connect many Gandirosha traditions to Sokhivar.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
